Write one sentence describing your emotions at this Problem part of your story.
When the Problem felt most difficult, what did you try to do? Did you eventually push through an issue, step away, ask for help, or something else?
Write one sentence describing your emotions at this Action part of your story.
What happened immediately after your Actions?
Write one sentence describing your emotions at this part of your story.

rows.gen_context_content: I had school during the day, then I came back to campus to go to the gym
rows.gen_context_reflect: it was good, and I was excited to go to the gym
rows.gen_problem_content: I didn't know the main entrance was closed, but it was. It was clear where the new entrance was because the lights, and there was a ramp leading up to the new entrance
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I thought it was cool and made me excited to go to the gym. I was glad they made it clear where the main entrance was
rows.gen_action_content: I followed the sign that said entrance, and when i got inside i showed them my student id. i didn't understand it but they showed me
rows.gen_action_reflect: i was a little bit confused at first but then i got assistance so i knew what to do
rows.gen_resolution_content: I got let into the gym and i was able to do my workout
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: happy that i was able to start

rows.gen_context_content: I finished my classes and assignments for the day, so I got ready to go to the gym.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was happy and excited because I love to be active and going to the gym is something I always look forward to doing.
rows.gen_problem_content: The gym would sometimes remove equipment because they wanted to reorganize what they had. So they took out some of my favorite machines.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: Due to the fact that some of my favorite machines were removed from the gym, I felt sad because I always thought those machines were reliable and helped me on my gym goals.
rows.gen_action_content: I would push through the problem by trying out new machines, but eventually I ended up going to a different gym that had the machines I liked because the current gym wasn't bringing any new machines yet.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I felt happy because I was able to get back into what I was trying to do in the first place.
rows.gen_resolution_content: I would leave the new gym and go back to my apartment.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I would be very satisfied because the new gym had everything I needed.

rows.gen_context_content: Before my last experience I had a couple classes and I accomplihsed taking some good notes and then after class I just went home to change and grab a protein bar and then head off to the gym.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I would say I was a little bit tired from class but I wanted to go to the gym to boost my motivation and get what I needed to get done
rows.gen_problem_content: The gym was very crowded so I had to wait for a lot of the machines to open up
rows.gen_problem_reflect: It was a bit upsetting because I wanted to get a quick gym session done before I had a lot of other things to do for the rest of the day
rows.gen_action_content: I just tried to wait patiently or I did some other machines I needed to do that were open or I did my floor workout since mats were always open
rows.gen_action_reflect: I would say I was still motivated to get my gym sessiond done
rows.gen_resolution_content: After I waited the machines usually woudl open up so I get to use it now
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I would say I am a bit more happy because I finally got to do the machine I wanted to do

rows.gen_context_content: I wanted to rent out something from the gym. But many of the equipment was either broken or unusable.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I felt frustrated with my options.
rows.gen_problem_content: The staff cannot do much except check it out to you.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: understanding but still kinda frustrated with the situation
rows.gen_action_content: I would try to submit a request to the gym about getting more newer equipment, as we do pay our money towards the recreation program. I would maybe try to suggest a system of feedback forms.
rows.gen_action_reflect: Hopeful as many of the staff are students, so they can understand where I am coming from
rows.gen_resolution_content: They start having a form up front to submit feedback. They also might have newer equipment now
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: satisfied and happy

rows.gen_context_content: I'm in class, just waiting to get out so I can hit the gym.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I feel happy
rows.gen_problem_content: There class work and home work that difficult for accomplish of what I want.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I feel pressure.
rows.gen_action_content: If the day I had less homework I will go gym, if there many homework I will do yoga in home.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I feel kink of what decision I should make.
rows.gen_resolution_content: I feel better after I work out. Feeling fresh to walk out the gym or do some stretching
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: happy

rows.gen_context_content: On Wednesday, I had just came back to my apartment from a long shift at work. My other apartment mates had just gotten home from their classes and lab as well. We were sitting in the living room all together eating dinner when one of them had suggested that we go to the gym. All 3 of us were down, we were going to go to the apartments gym, but I pointed out that our gym doesnt have the same machines as the ones at Rimac. So one of them suggested we go to Rimac. We all said yes and started getting ready to go. When we got there it seemed like it was going to be a good session. There was barely anyone there and we all split up to different machines. I headed over to the assisted pull up machine to warm myself up for a back and bi day.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was excited to go to the gym with 2 of my friends, I hadnt gone to rimac in a long time.
rows.gen_problem_content: When I got to the assisted pull up machine, I noticed the pin to hold down the weights was gone. Making the machine to be out of order. There was another machine on the other side of the gym, but the pin for that one was gone too.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I was pretty dissapointed, I was looking forward to using that specific machine.
rows.gen_action_content: I went to my friends and complained about the pin being missing. Then one of them suggested I just do lat pull downs instead, which I was going to go do eventually. The other suggested that I try doing pull ups without the assistance. I just listened to their suggestions and went to go loose hang on one of the normal bars. I did try to do a pull up with no help, but it was more of a stretch. Then I went to go do lat pull downs because it was my next on my routine anyways.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I kinda accpeted that they were broken and moved onto my next part of the routine.
rows.gen_resolution_content: the lat pull downs were fine, I wasnt too sad about the broken machines after completing the rest of my workout. Either way I was able to get into the gym and use the machines while it wasn't busy. After the gym me and my friends went back to our apartment and scrolled on our phones for a bit. It was still a good day.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I was content, I did the rest of my workout perfectly fine and still had a good day.

rows.gen_context_content: Before this situation, I was a bit bored and wanted do something fun, but that was also productive in some way. I wanted to accomplish trying something new, but also moving my body.
rows.gen_context_reflect: At this point, I am a bit nervous about trying something new, but looking forward to the class.
rows.gen_problem_content: Trying new things can be scary, and I have never taken an exercise class before.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I'm nervous to go into the room and do things in front of other people.
rows.gen_action_content: I would push through the nervousness and join the class, but I would clarify with an instructor or other participant that I'm at the right spot.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I'm feeling a bit more relaxed after talking to someone and having things clarified.
rows.gen_resolution_content: Immediately after my action, I would join the class and enjoy the time. I would feel good after working out, and plan to come back the next week.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I'm feeling relaxed and happy, glad I joined the class.

rows.gen_context_content: I wake up at 7am to try the campus gym. My hope is to complete a light full-body workout.
rows.gen_context_reflect: Tired and a little anxious to try out a new gym.
rows.gen_problem_content: Even early in the morning, the gym was very crowded. There were lines for most of the machines I wanted to use, and the weights were in use as well.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: Disappointed about the wait and stressed about the crowd
rows.gen_action_content: I waited in line for the main equipment I wanted to use. After an hour, I left with only half of my usual workout done.
rows.gen_action_reflect: Disappointed and defeated
rows.gen_resolution_content: I went home and signed up for a gym off campus.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: disappointed in the on-campus gym, but happy to try something different

rows.gen_context_content: Before my last experience I was attempting to attend the RIMAC gym on campus and attend a quick lift session.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was super excited to head to the gym as it was something I was looking forward to during my day.
rows.gen_problem_content: I went into the gym and worked out for about 30 minutes, even though I knew it was very packed and super stuffy inside. There were a lot of students inside the gym which made it difficult to workout and made it super humid and hot inside.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I was a little upset that I had to end my gym session early.
rows.gen_action_content: I tried to workout for a little longer, but ended up leaving the gym to step outside for fresh air.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I felt better and more relaxed stepping outside the gym.
rows.gen_resolution_content: Immediately after my action, I realized it was better to leave the gym and come back another time when it was less crowded. I also realized I could have checked the app to see when the gym was most likely to be packed or not, which could have prevented this issue.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I felt better leaving the gym knowing I could come another day, but a little annoyed at myself because I could have checked the school app to see when the best time to attend the gym was.

rows.gen_context_content: I went into the gym with the goal of doing legs in mind, with a specific order and routine planned.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was feeling motivated and happy to begin my session.
rows.gen_problem_content: There was a lot of people here, specifically men, using the machines and weights that I use for leg day.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I felt a bit overwhelmed, since smaller spaces with tons of people is kind of scary. Also, since everything I was planning on using was being taken.
rows.gen_action_content: I patiently waited to the side for a machine to open up, since it's kind of intimidating to walk up to any of them and ask when they would be done. I also made some changes to the routine that I was planning on doing, and tried some new exercises with what was available instead.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I felt calmer, since I was pushing through, by either waiting patiently, or finding something else to do. However, still kind of overwhelmed.
rows.gen_resolution_content: After the gym, I left feeling happy that I pushed through and did as much as I could. I walked out with an open mind, hoping next time their would be more women so its easier to approach them.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I felt happy to be leaving and finally done.

rows.gen_context_content: I was finishing up homework and discussing with my suitemates how we wanted to be more active and use RIMAC more often. We decided to go to the gym together that night.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was excited to start working out more and use the campus resources more like the gym and the gym classes that are offered.
rows.gen_problem_content: As we walked into the gym, we discovered that the weight room was completely full. All the machines were taken up and it looked like there was a line waiting for each machine already.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I felt frustrated because it was already late at night and I assumed that the gym would be more empty.
rows.gen_action_content: I tried to see if other rooms were less full. I walked into the room with the cardio machines like the treadmill and stairmaster. At first glance, this room seemed more empty but as I walked closer to the machines, I discovered that half of them were broken.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I still felt hopeful at first but as I walked closer to the machines I felt frustrated again.
rows.gen_resolution_content: I decided to the leave the gym after finding nowhere to workout.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I left feeling disappointed and discouraged.

rows.gen_context_content: I was watching videos on YouTube on how to get better at tennis returns, like with the machines. I figured the gym doesn't have machines, so I found a good substitute with using a wall. I heard the rec gyms have a hitting wall, so I was looking it up.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was excited at trying out the hitting wall, but also confused about how to find it
rows.gen_problem_content: The lack of clear directions, and not enough information about certain amenities. I'm still looking up images on my phone to find the hitting wall at the gym
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I was starting to accept my fate, that I probably wouldn't find much information on the school rec website. So I considered looking on TikTok, but then I decided I would look for it in person
rows.gen_action_content: I was just walking around the gym, different floors. I asked someone in the room if this was the hitting room, but they said I need to reserve it. Since I didn't find anything on the website, I just went into the hitting wall room
rows.gen_action_reflect: I was just happy that I found it. I was a little irritated it took so long and I couldn't find it without being there. It is what it is.
rows.gen_resolution_content: I started to play tennis. I was enjoying finally getting my hit practice. But I did notice the room was really hot, but may have just been me. I also thought it was a one-way glass, I didn't realize everyone could see me while they were on the stairmaster. but it is what it is
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I was just focused at that point, at improving my return rate.

rows.gen_context_content: I was eating a preworkout snack right before hitting the gym. I was hoping to hit my protein goal for the day and have a little more fuel for back and bi day.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I felt hyped and couldn't wait to put on a good playlist and max out on my sets. I felt stronger today and unstoppable.
rows.gen_problem_content: I realized that I was short on time and did not have enough time to wait for the shoulder press to open up. There seemed to be a line of individuals waiting for it. The shoulder press is the most important machine during my back and bi workout. Without it, my workout will feel incomplete.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I was stressed out, not knowing if I should skip that particular workout and just do cardio. I was also upset because that machine is usually never busy, and it only gained popularity just recently.
rows.gen_action_content: Since the line was too long and I was running out of time, I just ended up doing cardio.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I wasn't the happiest doing cardio, as I prefer it less than weighted workouts. I felt as if I did not complete all the workout and that it wasn't worth it.
rows.gen_resolution_content: I left the gym feeling incomplete and unfullfilled. I walked back to my dorm regretting that I had not waited in the line.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I felt very incomplete and sad. I also felt mad at myself for not sticking to my discipline and for making excuses.

rows.gen_context_content: I was sitting at my desk, looking at my computer for opportunities on campus to practice wellness, exercise, etc.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was generally content and hopeful to find something that sounds fun, interesting, and doable.
rows.gen_problem_content: I found a great opportunity offered by my RA to do a yoga class in the park. However, we were instructed to bring our own yoga mats, but I didn't have my own mat.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I was a bit frustrated and disappointed that I couldn't attend this class simply because I didn't own my own yoga mat.
rows.gen_action_content: I essentially stepped away from the issue and brushed it aside. I knew I didn't have a yoga mat, so I ignored the email and closed my computer. Then, I stepped away from my desk.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I was still a little frustrated, but not as much as before.
rows.gen_resolution_content: I decided to leave my room and go on a walk around campus.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I was content and happy to be outside.

rows.gen_context_content: i was in class running sligthly late, i wanted to leave as soon as possible cuz it was a 10 min walk to RIMAC gym and i wanted to be as on time as possible since i was excited for my first pilates class
rows.gen_context_reflect: i was slightly stressed since i was late but also excited mostly becase of the actual class
rows.gen_problem_content: slightly late so people had already taken their places and equipment, it was kinda hard to figure out exactly what we needed and what exercise we were beginning with since i missed a part of the briefing
rows.gen_problem_reflect: more stressed now definitely but like kinda looking around to understand whats going on and so i can get started asap
rows.gen_action_content: i just spoke to the girls around me and they just helped me grab what i need really quick. after that it was into stretching and begging the actual class so it was ok then
rows.gen_action_reflect: feeling much better happy to get started, also talking to people around me was nice
rows.gen_resolution_content: we just continued with the class, it was weighted sit ups. i did it with a partner one of the girls in the background
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: happy, excited to be in the class also made friends

rows.gen_context_content: After class, I wanted to go to the gym with my friend. We walked to the gym and talked as we walked.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was excited to work out as I was looking forward to it all day.
rows.gen_problem_content: The gym was full, and every piece of equipment was being used. We had to wait in line for some of the exercises.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I was frustrated and getting tired of waiting.
rows.gen_action_content: We decided to change our exercises and do more bodyweight activities so we don't have to wait so long.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I was a little disappointed, but overall didn't care much.
rows.gen_resolution_content: We were able to leave the gym before it got dark.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: Happy to be out of the gym

rows.gen_context_content: I woke up at around 5am to try to get to the gym right when it opened so I could still make it to my 8am class. But its a bit of a far walk and theres usually a line of people outside.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I am very tired and unmotivated.
rows.gen_problem_content: After waiting in line, I enter the gym and most of the time the machines I want to use are already taken.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I am now frustrated and annoyed.
rows.gen_action_content: I try to reframe my workout so that I can still be productive but its not always something I want to do nor makes sense with the workouts I did previous day.
rows.gen_action_reflect: Annoyed
rows.gen_resolution_content: After my workout I now feel unproductive and like I wasted my time because I wasnt able to follow my set routine.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: frustrated

rows.gen_context_content: I'm bored during summer break. I have the idea to sign up for a summer recreation class to keep busy and get some exercise.
rows.gen_context_reflect: Bordem
rows.gen_problem_content: I try to sign up on the laptop for a summer recreation class in women's boxing. But when I try it says I need to pay Summer Pass Fees.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: Confused
rows.gen_action_content: I write an email to the UCSD recreation office mentioning my problem. They tell me I have to either pay for a pass or be enrolled in a Summer Session class to be eligible. The problem is, I am enrolled in Summer Session classes! I email them back saying this.
rows.gen_action_reflect: Annoyed
rows.gen_resolution_content: They ignore my reply. I never end up being able to take the women's boxing class, even though I really wanted to learn self-defense. I give up and sit on my couch bored scrolling through TV channels while the summer sun shines outside.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: defeat

rows.gen_context_content: After attending all my lectures for the day, I wanted to go to the ucsd recreation center to play ping pong.
rows.gen_context_reflect: Happy to be finished with my classess for the day to do something I wanted to for myself.
rows.gen_problem_content: Rimac is overcrowded and no ping pong tables are currently available
rows.gen_problem_reflect: Frustrated on not being able to play ping pong
rows.gen_action_content: Scanning the tables and ASK PEOPLE if we can share the tables or if the people would be leaving soon(guarantee a spot after they leave).
rows.gen_action_reflect: Neutral. More concerned on solving the problem with curiosity
rows.gen_resolution_content: The tables were all full and people refused to let me join and play. So I left RIMAC
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: Frustrated but a little sad

rows.gen_context_content: I just drank my matcha latte and had a quick bite and now walking downstairs to go to my apartment gym.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I feel awake and ready to get a good workout in.
rows.gen_problem_content: Everyone is at the gym and taking the hip-thrust machine and the squat racks.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I am feeling annoyed and frustrated because I wanted to hit legs.
rows.gen_action_content: If all the machines that I wanted were taken, I just start running on the treadmill. I usually try for 1-2 miles hoping people just leave by then.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I am still a little annoyed because I don't like cardio but I'd rather do that then having to wait for the machines.
rows.gen_resolution_content: Some machines would open up after I'm done running like the hip-thrust machine and I would start my leg day.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I feel happy because I'm done running and good about myself now that I get to start a good workout.

rows.gen_context_content: I was hanging out with my friends, and we decided we should all get more active; being active together would allow us to stay motivated. This made us think and decide that we should join one of the UCSD recreation classes available.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was excited to go to a recreational class with my friend, so we were all happy that we thought of this idea.
rows.gen_problem_content: Our main concern was that we couldn't find a time that overlapped with everyone's availability because we all have different class schedules. The classes we wanted to take together may have only had options twice a week, and those times wouldn't work for all of us.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: It felt disappointing that we couldn't do the class all together. We were frustrated as this was the second time this had happened to us.
rows.gen_action_content: We tried to reschedule for next week, but our UCSD class times are always the same, and so are the recreational classes. We also tried to do another class together but then some friends weren't as interested and therefore dropped out of the plan.
rows.gen_action_reflect: It was overwhelming as we were trying to see if there was even a point in going for the classes. We all tried to think from a place of resolution so we could get a outcome that we all are happy with.
rows.gen_resolution_content: We couldn't necessarily find a class that all of us could go to together, so we decided to just go individually at the times that worked best for ourselves. We went for the recreational classes but just on our own.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: It was upsetting to not be able to go with my friends but i felt fine because i can hang out with them in other ways and at other times. it would have just been great to be able to go together. we all still enjoyed our class individually.

rows.gen_context_content: I was at my dorm and just made breakfast which was 2 eggs and 2 pieces of toast. I was making sure that I had energy for the gym because the night before I wanted to go to the gym in the morning to start my day off productively.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was feeling a little groggy, tired, and slightly unmotivated to go to the gym because it was early in the morning.
rows.gen_problem_content: I was waiting for a long time for a weight machine for your legs, but either the person was taking really long time or someone would take the machine before I had the chance to.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I was pretty frustrated, annoyed, and starting to become more impatient.
rows.gen_action_content: I decided to go up and ask them how many sets they had left because they were taking a longer time than usual.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I was a little annoyed, but I also felt bad for asking because I don't like interrupting people's workouts.
rows.gen_resolution_content: the person working out on the weight machine said they have 2 sets left. I waited off to the side of the machine for them to finish.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I felt relief, anticipation for using the machine, and was slightly impatient while I was waiting.

rows.gen_context_content: I was sitting at home having a coffee.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was upset for pretty much the entire day, from an academic dispute
rows.gen_problem_content: The difficulty I encountered was that my day started bad when the dog got loose on the way to go do the campus rec, as a result affecting the gym experience.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: My emotions were pure anger and frustration.
rows.gen_action_content: The problem that felt the most difficult in this situation was trying to work given this whole event, the action/solution to this was taking a breather during the campus rec activity and being aware of my surroundings.
rows.gen_action_reflect: My emotions were more calm and happy I made it to the campus rec activity.
rows.gen_resolution_content: Immediately after the characters day went way better than expected and they home calm.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: Very pleased

rows.gen_context_content: I had just finished a lecture and was hanging out with my friend. Before the archery class started, I was telling my friend how excited I was about taking the free class and hope to join the club.
rows.gen_context_reflect: I was very excited and enthusiastic about attending the class.
rows.gen_problem_content: Everyone else seemed very experienced in archery, whereas I had no experience at all. Everyone was in groups with their friends and buddied up together at some posts. Since I decided to take the class on my own, I didn't have a friend nearby and felt lonely. Being inexperienced compared to everyone else made me feel left out.
rows.gen_problem_reflect: I felt out of place and awkward.
rows.gen_action_content: Instead of standing around and feeling awkward, I tried my best to go around and talk to new people. Eventually, I made my way into a group of girls who had taken the class before and I was no longer by myself.
rows.gen_action_reflect: I felt relieved I wasn't isolated from everyone else and felt happy I met new people.
rows.gen_resolution_content: The group of girls taught me how to use a bow and shoot an arrow. I had a great experience during the class and decided to join the club with them.
rows.gen_resolution_reflect: I was happy the class went well and excited to join the club with my new friends.
